gold.question: Among all of the derivative instruments that Verizon used to manage the exposure to fluctuations of foreign currencies exchange rates or interest rates, which one had the highest notional value in FY 2021?
gold.answer: Cross currency swaps. Its notional value was $32,502 million.
gold.evidence:
Derivative Instruments

swaps, forward starting interest rate swaps, treasury rate locks, interest rate caps, swaptions and foreign exchange forwards. We do not hold
